pages.title: Install
pages.text: Right-click a $(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l).$(br2)One per heater. It is consumed and can't be removed.

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)+50%$() output$(li)Faster warm-up, same target$(li)Double open-camp radius: basic 14 blocks, Diamond 28, before exposure or frostmite penalties$(li)Thermostats work as normal
Refined Acheronite top and bottom, Thermal Cores on the sides, a $(l:threats/frostbitten)Frostbitten Core$(/l) center.$(br2)$(flavor)Costs an arm and a leg. The arms won't have frostbite.$()
